channel.title: Luis Arévalo
channel.description: Aerospace engineer in Madrid. I write about what I learn using AI to work better.

item.title: Building is easy now. Knowing what to build isn't
item.description: With AI, anyone can put together an app that looks finished in an afternoon. But a working screen isn't a product. Here's what I think comes next.

item.title: One AI envoy for every team
item.description: What slows work down most isn't technology but waiting on other teams. An idea I came across: give every team an AI agent that keeps track of its commitments. Here's my take.

item.title: Being busy is no longer a badge of honour
item.description: Someone I know who works in AI argues that busy people will be the biggest losers of this era. I agree, and this is what I think will happen in the coming months.
